question: For $\vec{a}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=-5\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$, verify the commutative property of vector addition.
explanation:
Step 1: Calculation of $\vec{a}+\vec{b}$
\(\vec{a}+\vec{b}=(3-5)\hat{i}+(-2+4)\hat{j}+(1+2)\hat{k}\)
Thus,
\(\vec{a}+\vec{b}=-2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}\)
Step 2: Calculation of $\vec{b}+\vec{a}$
\(\vec{b}+\vec{a}=(-5+3)\hat{i}+(4-2)\hat{j}+(2+1)\hat{k}\)
Therefore,
\(\vec{b}+\vec{a}=-2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}\)
Step 3: Comparison
Both orders of addition produce the same vector.
Final Answer
$\vec{a}+\vec{b}=\vec{b}+\vec{a}$, verifying the commutative property.
